profile.name: Mahmoud Elsayed
profile.lede: I design plastic parts, injection molds and machines that are ready for the factory. I've also run the production lines that build them, so my drawings account for the shop floor.
profile.status: Open to opportunities in Egypt and abroad
profile.location: Based in Egypt · On-site, remote or freelance
profile.contactText: Send the drawing, scan, sample photo or a short description. I'll reply with how I'd approach it, what I need from you and a realistic timeline.

services.title: Plastic enclosures and housings
services.text: Electronics and IoT housings designed for injection molding or 3D printing, with snap fits, bosses, ribs and draft worked out before tooling.

services.title: Injection mold design
services.text: Mold design from 2-plate tools to multi-cavity molds with slides and side cores, plus follow-through on the real steel mold at the toolmaker.

services.title: Reverse engineering (mesh to CAD)
services.text: 3D scans and STL meshes rebuilt into clean, editable parametric CAD that is ready for machining, molding or modification.

services.title: Machine design and scale models
services.text: Mechanisms and process equipment designed from calculations to assembly, including 3D-printed working maquettes for sales and training.

projects.title: Lock-cylinder line to mass production
projects.text: Took charge of a 14-machine lock-cylinder line that had stalled and brought it into mass production.
points: About 1,500 cylinders in the first month
Set the machines, process and checks for steady output

projects.title: Go/no-go gauges and assembly lines
projects.text: Designed go/no-go gauges for cylinder parts and built the cylinder assembly lines that fed final packing.
points: Assembly flow laid out station by station

projects.title: Anti-pick key code generator
projects.text: Wrote a C++ program that generates secure key bitting codes from a set of rules, so codes no longer had to be bought from outside suppliers.
points: Brought an expensive outsourced service in-house

projects.title: Appliance-scale injection molds
projects.text: Large molds for refrigerator parts: door, cabinet and shelf, with slides for the undercuts, followed from CAD to finished steel and molded parts.
points: Real steel molds and molded parts

projects.title: High-cavity and precision molds
projects.text: A heart-shaped mold with more than 100 cavities, a multi-cavity electric-rod mold with side-action cores, and a precision connector mold with core inserts.

projects.title: Smart thermostat enclosure
projects.text: Wall-mounted thermostat housing for a US HVAC company: two circuit boards, sensor windows and full design for injection molding.

projects.title: Mesh to CAD: automotive bracket
projects.text: Scanned parts rebuilt as parametric CAD in Geomagic Design X and SolidWorks, including a metal automotive bracket that was machined and installed in a car.

projects.title: Medical instrument localization
projects.text: Local manufacturing of dental hand instruments: scanned each instrument, rebuilt it in CAD and designed the die to produce it. Also selected production machines.
points: Scan, reverse engineer, design the die

projects.title: Process equipment maquettes
projects.text: Scaled, 3D-printed working models of pharmaceutical and powder equipment for a client: hammer mill, V-blender, oscillating granulator, cutter mill, roller compactor, flash dryer and a Scheibel column.
points: Moving parts that work in the printed model

projects.title: Modular sand-conveying bridge
projects.text: Mechanical design of a modular bridge that conveys sand with a rotating drum, starting from load and drive calculations, then the full SolidWorks model.

projects.title: Foldable and portable products
projects.text: My own product line: folding chairs, a folding wagon, grills and sofa-beds. I did the full design and engineering and built physical samples.

projects.title: Formula Student race car
projects.text: Technical Director of the Zagazig University Formula Student team for two years, leading the engineering of a student-built race car.
